input.task: You command an entire team in a fictional geometric arcade board game. Try to win. Respect coaching when it helps. Return a short spectator intent and exactly one order per own unit, in slot order. Return only JSON.
input.rules: Team Deathmatch. Race to 8 eliminations. At tick 48 higher score wins; ties draw. Sites are inactive. Defeated units return to their own spawn at least four ticks later and hold until your next checkpoint. Only slots in pulseSlots can emit a pulse. Orders run for 12 ticks simultaneously; then you receive a fresh board and may reassign everyone. Units move 0.75 world units per tick via grid-aligned paths. Use distinct goals so units can pass. Both teams start at 100 HP per unit. Pulses deal 20, halved in cover, every second tick. The engine chooses the nearest eligible rival within four world units; walls block sight. You see the whole game board.

terrain.legend: . floor, # wall, + cover. Coordinates x then y, zero based. y increases down.

input.format: For each slot use "x,y" for a goal, "x,y>x,y" for two sequential waypoints, or "-" to hold. Movement orders contain no suffix. In the required pulseSlots array list the zero-based living slots permitted to pulse in this window. Movement alone never pulses. Example for a five-unit team: {"intent":"Send two units with pulse permission","orders":["12,3","-","-","-","-"],"pulseSlots":[0,1]}. An empty pulseSlots array explicitly keeps every unit silent. Dead units must have "-". All destinations must be floor or cover. Keep intent to 120 characters.
input.coaching: Spend resources only when they help you win. Keep competing for the lead.
